description: Follows Andrew Wiles from Fermat’s Last Theorem through elliptic curves, modular forms and the Frey–Serre–Ribet reduction to semistable modularity. Explains Galois representations and deformation–Hecke comparisons, the gap in the 1993 announcement and the revised argument with Richard Taylor, distinguishing the 1995 result from the later full modularity theorem.
